source: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast
compiledFrom: Cross-checked against open5e, MIT-licensed for its own data structuring, resolved against the official SRD text where needed.
monstersNote: Single-source compile from open5e, no second full 2024 dataset exists to cross-check against the way 2014 had. Damage types are extracted from the description text, not open5e's own structured field, which is confirmed unreliable on both editions. Not individually verified entry-by-entry the way Conditions and Weapon Properties were, validated only in aggregate (missing-field checks, damage-extraction coverage, spot checks). Treat with more caution than the other categories in this repo until it gets real spot-checking against the official text.
spellsNote: Same single-source caveat as monsters. Spell-level damage type, unlike monster attacks, checked reliable against known examples (Fireball, Magic Missile, Ice Knife all correct) and used directly from the source field. Greater Invisibility's description was missing from open5e; confirmed and filled in directly from D&D Beyond's official spell page rather than left blank or backfilled from old 2014 wording.
